oracle_records.name: Along the Crooked Way
oracle_records.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Whenever a creature card leaves your graveyard, amass Goblins 1.
{1}{B}: Goblins and Orcs you control gain menace until end of turn.

oracle_records.name: Dredger's Insight
oracle_records.oracle_text:
Whenever one or more artifact and/or creature cards leave your graveyard, you gain 1 life.
When this enchantment enters, mill four cards. You may put an artifact, creature, or land card from among the milled cards into your hand. (To mill four cards, put the top four cards of your library into your graveyard.)

oracle_records.name: Pyromancer's Goggles
oracle_records.oracle_text: {T}: Add {R}. When that mana is spent to cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.

authority.conclusion: CR106.6/106.6a establishes a DTA per mana;603.7a explicitly permits earlier events making triggering impossible, and603.7b gives no loss/ineligible-spend expiry. Official FDN notes establish independence and per-mana triggers but do not adjudicate expiry. Both independent reviewers found no contrary primary authority. Previous pool-only expiry inference is retracted.
authority.xmage_limit: Pinned Goggles uses a card-level Zone.ALL MANA_PAID observer rather than a faithful explicit DTA lifetime object; it supplies no authoritative rule ending the DTA when mana disappears.

implementation: Existing cold ManaState owns optional boxed sorted/deduplicated exact ObjectRef roots for inert untriggered copy DTAs. Active pools still carry per-unit copy information; ordinary producer provenance never creates a root.

Positive ineligible spending and actual step/turn mana loss transfer exact source identity to inert roots. These roots persist through cleanup, control change and source departure/reentry. New incarnation stays separate. No source facts or private card/mana metadata is required.

Actual qualified red instant/sorcery payment continues to create one counterable copy trigger per mana under106.6a. The qualified units are not retained as inert DTAs; after their packets and spell leave the stack, no waiting root remains absent other actual untriggered units.

State pruning and owned heap accounting retain/count the cold vector. Public observation emits sorted exact inert sources only, so states with different future legal source choices remain distinguishable without hidden hand/library/amount data.

Shared public movement helper captures departing public object even for destinationBF. The general zone-trigger dispatcher makes that exception only for actual typed graveyard-departure conditions; ordinary ETB remains new-entrant only.
